body:
Python reference (vendor_mac_gen.py, sent to founder) + PARENA stdlib stub (stdlib/pentest/macspoof.prn, commit bda8378) generating realistic MAC addresses with real vendor OUI prefixes for Samsung/Microsoft/Apple/Broadcom, for testing network security controls on future hardware. Also flagged a real risk on the current box (KVM/virtio_net, possible MAC-filtered hypervisor bridge) before scripting sudo-queue/23, built with a scheduled auto-revert safety net. Confirmed no prior 'ARGUS security' documentation exists anywhere in this environment.

⚓ ☃
title: Vendor-realistic MAC generation tooling — S193-01 done
